messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Service and Subscription Management" as it appears in the following examples.
['This is your official notification that the service (s) listed below will be deactivated and deleted if your profile is not verified immediately.', 'If this action was made by the third person, and you want to unsubscribe, click on the link under the subscription options in this message, and then change the password on your account, possibly it was stolen.', 'Thank you for registering for 3D Secure.', 'Please increase your mailbox size to 9500GB Storage.', 'Our record indicates that you recently made a request to shutdown your e-mail and this request will be processed shortly.', 'If this purchasing was made by the third person, and you want to cancel the subscription, click on the link under the subscription options in this email, and then change the password on your account, maybe it was stolen.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We notify you about service deactivation, account verification, registration, mailbox upgrades, and subscription cancellation or management options."}
